business_problem: Sýn needed to reduce heavy operational toil, replace a fragmented custom systems landscape, and build a unified customer view that could support better marketing, service, and digital experiences across its telecom business.
solution_summary: Sýn adopted MongoDB Atlas as the core of a cloud-first modernization effort that connected legacy systems, marketing tools, and customer data into one platform. Atlas stores the operational data for new applications and provides the ACID-compliant document model the team needed without forcing a full rebuild from scratch. Atlas App Services and Atlas Triggers orchestrate event-driven integrations with Segment.io, Customer.io, and Salesforce so marketing and service workflows can react to customer behavior. Atlas Charts gives teams simple visualizations, while Atlas Data Federation helps old systems talk to each other as Sýn builds a 360-degree customer view across websites, campaigns, emails, calls, and other touchpoints. That combination lets the telecom operator move away from dozens of disconnected tools, keep product and service development moving faster, and support a more personalized customer experience without carrying the old operational burden forward.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Acts as the core multi-cloud database for new applications and the shared customer-data foundation for Sýn's modernization program.

solution_components.name: Atlas App Services
solution_components.role: Provides the trigger-based application services Sýn uses to support event-driven integrations around customer and marketing data.

solution_components.name: Atlas Triggers
solution_components.role: Pushes customer-data events into downstream marketing and service workflows as operational data changes.

solution_components.name: Atlas Charts
solution_components.role: Delivers simple data visualizations for teams working with operational and customer data.

solution_components.name: Atlas Data Federation
solution_components.role: Helps legacy systems and newer MongoDB-based services share data during the transition to a unified platform.

data_flow: Website, campaign, email, call-center, and internal-system data are merged into MongoDB Atlas, Atlas Triggers and App Services route events to Segment.io, Customer.io, and Salesforce, and Atlas Charts plus Data Federation expose a 360-degree customer view across the business.
business_outcome: MongoDB helped Sýn build a 360-degree customer view, reduce operational friction, and improve how it designs products, marketing, and service experiences for telecom customers.
